title: Quarterly cadence & orchestration for customer-hosted (VPC / on-prem) features
creator: Elena Park
description: Goal: Define and operationalize a repeatable quarterly planning cadence that aligns Product, Eng, Solutions, and CS for customer-hosted deployments (VPC & air-gapped on-prem). Scope includes release windows, upgrade gating, OKR mapping to initiatives, rollout automation primitives, and runbooks for regulatory/compliance customers. This ticket synthesizes cross-functional inputs, converts them into milestones, and produces the playbook + checklist that will be used by the Delivery org for Q2 activations.
acceptance_criteria: Quarterly playbook (Confluence) completed and reviewed by Eng, Security, and CS
Roadmap milestones with dates and owners added to shared calendar and sprint boards
Compatibility matrix generator spec created and handed to Eng for implementation
Ops runbook for air-gapped installers validated in a staging dry-run with Solutions Eng
OKRs linked to initiatives and measurable signals defined (latency P50/P95, upgrade success %, customer rollback events)

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Upgrades fail for customers with custom networking. Mitigation: Add preflight network checks and a pre-upgrade simulation step in playbook.
Risk: KMS integration timelines slip. Mitigation: Provide a documented fallback with customer-managed key reference and plan for emergency rollback.
Risk: Limited Eng bandwidth during sprint ramp. Mitigation: Defer low-impact automation to next quarter and prioritize manual-run runbooks for immediate needs.
Risk: Telemetry gaps for private instances. Mitigation: Define minimal telemetry shim and include it in installer; partner with Observability team to onboard customers.
Risk: Regulatory customers require extended review windows. Mitigation: Publish regulatory checklist and extend pre-activation calendar to include legal/security sign-offs.
